synthesis.overall: Five complete 16-panel pilot stories now have character choices, local outcomes and continuing hooks. They are readable illustrated pilots with attractive distinct worlds, not fully consistent final comic production.
synthesis.NG: Aren choosing Pell over the delivery gives the rescue emotional weight; lost payment and the old Lower District letter extend the story. Car-roof repair improves geography. Tether endpoints, hand assignments, glove states and platform transitions remain inconsistent.
synthesis.BP: The grief nickname and failed memory test give the horror rule personal stakes; freeing Neris and recovering the nursery clue provide outcome and hook. Plant/lift turning logic, severed-root geography, guard laterality and coat-tear persistence remain weak.
synthesis.ST: The loud failure followed by noticing the ram dislikes noise creates the clearest behavioral solution and warmest character interplay. Padded bell and negotiated ride land. RIGHT charge to LEFT puff, fading chip and repaired brown boots interrupt continuity; destination hook is gentler than an unresolved threat.
synthesis.RC: Large jaw impacts, voluntary challenge, red wrist cost and the lender-eye reveal carry strong visual energy. Personal need for the key is thinly established; receiving/charging/punch sides, dark core state, reward object and wrist marks drift. RC15-P preserves the subtler existing eye before RC16.
synthesis.FL: Coat/footprint investigation, water memory, admission of dismissal, visible extraction and former-employer hook make a full rescue mystery. Memory with contact rings contradicts the strict no-ripple rule; C-head lower countercontact remains unproven, and glove/key/hand states drift.
synthesis.medium_and_surface: Finishes materially calm competing floor, grass, stone, water and costume marks while keeping faces and silhouettes. RC becomes more geometric and FL sometimes substantially cleaner than its scratchy source; FL04 is the clearest tradeoff. BP12 coat notches and RC11 debris are redrawn, so exact pixel or semantic preservation is not claimed.
synthesis.lettering_and_pacing: All five complete chronological phone reads were personally inspected in the linked earlier reports. Final source replacements were checked as 34 matched phone pairs, plus eight final lettered adjacency spot checks. Those spots preserve dialogue legibility and focal hands/faces. Full final chapters were not redundantly re-read; earlier story-level conclusions remain qualified by changed rendering. Repeated dry banter across protagonists limits voice differentiation.
synthesis.approval: No individual owner votes, canon, human comprehension success, measured comfort or owner acceptance are inferred from global praise or automated receipts.
